name: Hinohara Megumi
source:
Megumi, the energetic school council president, is easy to talk to and easy to befriend. Despite this, she never accepts invitations to events outside of school. Due to her secretive lifestyle, people tend to keep their distance. When around [url=https://vndb.org/c45783]Hideaki[/url], Megumi goes from energetic to an overjoyed puppy.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=144]MangaGamer[/url]]
